title: Exact Hausdorff dimension of Liouville quantum gravity
exact_target: For gamma in (0,2), determine the almost-sure Hausdorff dimension d_gamma of (C,D_h^gamma), with h a whole-plane Gaussian free field normalized by fixing its additive constant and D_h^gamma the canonical gamma-LQG metric. Beyond the known d_sqrt(8/3)=4, no exact value is established by this attempt.
historical_openness: Explicitly listed as open in the 2025 primary survey; limited 2026 primary-literature searches did not certify current status.
